description:
Value a Steam account's Rust skins. Every Rust skin the account holds with `quantity`, unit `price` and `value` (cents), sorted by value, and the
same attributes /skins filters on (`collection`, `creator`, `item_shortname`, `item_name`, `est_supply`,
`released_year`, `colors`, and `flags`: limited_time, permanent, marketable, tradable, breakable, glows,
commodity, drop), plus
`total_value`, `item_count`, `distinct_skins`, a `categories` breakdown with share percentages, the owner's
display name and avatar, and `value_history` (the current holdings re-priced at each of the last 365 days, in USD
DOLLARS, not cents, at each day's Steam sale price - so its latest point can be below `total_value`, which is at
current asking prices).
`found` is false for private or empty inventories; `stale` is true when Steam was unreachable and the last
stored snapshot was re-priced instead. Takes a 17-digit SteamID64 (use resolve_steam_profile for a profile URL or custom name); the inventory must be public. Served from the stored copy when the inventory was checked in the last 24 hours, otherwise read live from Steam. No key needed: keyless clients share a daily inventory cap; send your own free key (https://rust.wiki/api-keys) as X-API-Key for a private quota.

steamid.description: 17-digit SteamID64 (resolve URLs and vanity names with /players/resolve).

name: get_inventory
title: Value a Steam account's Rust skins
